result.stdout:
Description:
  Generates a REST HTTP API client from an OpenAPI description file.

Usage:
  requesty [options]

Options:
  -d, --openapi <path>                                                                                                                                                           The path or URI to the OpenAPI description file used to generate the code files.
  -o, --output <path>                                                                                                                                                            The output directory path for the generated code files. [default: ./output]
  --internal-type-access-modifiers                                                                                                                                               Makes every generated type internal instead of public.
  -n, --namespace-name <name>                                                                                                                                                    The root namespace to use for the generated handlers and models. [default: ApiSdk]
  --hcn, --http-client-name <name>                                                                                                                                               The name the generated handlers dispatch under (Consts.HttpClientName): the IHttpClientFactory client name and the key of the client's JSON options. Defaults to the description's info.title, or the namespace name when the title is missing.
  --ll, --log-level <Critical|Debug|Error|Information|None|Trace|Warning>                                                                                                        The log level to use when logging messages to the main output. [default: Warning]
  --ad, --additional-data                                                                                                                                                        Includes the 'AdditionalData' property for models. [default: true]
  --
[truncated]
